target.name: NEWLY_FLOODED
target.definition: DRY->FLOODED on pixels valid in both consecutive GFM scenes of the same event and AOI

regrid.target_resolution: nearest GloFAS proxy point; GFM working grid 64×64 is not the NWP grid
regrid.regridding_method: nearest-neighbor point sample at proxy lat/lon; no 20 m downscale

channels.name: STATE_AT_T0
channels.source: GloFAS reanalysis Q (Open-Meteo Flood API, forecast_days=0)
channels.timestamp: end of last complete Q calendar day before t0
channels.note: Not forecast forcing. Freshness recorded; currently FRESH on 183/183.

channels.name: FORECAST_FORCING
channels.source: WB2 IFS HRES total_precipitation_6hr (2016–2022); Open-Meteo Single Runs IFS (2024)
channels.note: Native steps only. No ERA5 in (t0,t1]. No interpolation of missing leads.

channels.name: FORCING_MASK
channels.resolution: hourly coverage of native windows; not 20 m
channels.note: M=0 precipitation is None, never 0.0 fill.

channels.name: STATIC_SPATIAL_FEATURES
channels.resolution: GFM working grid 64x64; native DEM/HAND as recorded in v2.1
channels.note: Unchanged. Not a substitute for vintage precipitation.

channels.name: STATE_FRESHNESS_MASK
channels.note: Currently constant FRESH; keep for future stale days. Do not drop pairs today.

forbidden: GloFAS Q after t0 as FORECAST_FORCING
